schemaVersion.description: Fixed schema version number (currently 1) for the site integration definition specification.

id.description: Unique kebab-case provider identifier matching the integration directory name (e.g. 'mangadex').

name.description: Human-readable display name for the manga site (e.g. 'MangaDex').

contributors.description: List of contributor names or handles who authored or maintain this site integration.

version.description: Semantic version string for the provider implementation (e.g. '1.0.0').

shipped.description: Whether this integration is bundled and active in runtime builds. Set to false for in-development scaffolds.

enabledByDefault.description: Default enablement state when the user has not explicitly configured this integration in Options.

patterns.description: URL matching rules for recognizing manga series and chapter pages supported by this integration.

seriesMatches.description: URL pathname patterns for series pages (e.g. ['/title/*']).

excludeMatches.description: URL pathname patterns explicitly excluded from series matching.

requiredOrigins.description: List of declarative URL pattern origins required for core site functionality.

optionalOrigins.description: List of optional URL pattern origins requested dynamically on demand (e.g. wildcard CDN or mirror domains).

policyDefaults.description: Default concurrency and rate-limiting delays for image downloads and chapter metadata requests.

image.description: Rate limiting policy for chapter image downloads.

chapter.description: Rate limiting policy for series/chapter metadata requests.

retryOwner.description: Determines whether retry classification and backoff are managed by the platform or owned by the provider adapter.

pageProbe.description: Whether this integration requires an active tab content-script probe to resolve reader/chapter state.

runtimes.description: Surface flags declaring which runtime contexts (background, offscreen) are implemented by this integration.

background.description: Whether the background runtime adapter is implemented.

offscreen.description: Whether the offscreen runtime adapter is implemented.

dispatchContext.description: Configuration for passing parsed context from active page to offscreen worker.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version for the dispatch context payload.

imageTransform.description: Image transformation requirements, such as canvas descrambling and estimated compute cost in milliseconds.

estimatedCostMs.description: Estimated CPU time in milliseconds per image transform.

endpointPolicies.description: Hardened network endpoint policies declaring allowed origins, credentials, response types, and byte limits.

dynamicOrigins.description: Dynamic origin bindings linking API endpoints that return dynamic media hosts.

sessionRefererRules.description: Declarative Net Request (DNR) session rules managed by the extension to attach required HTTP Referer headers.

customSettings.description: Custom user-configurable settings rendered in the Options UI for this integration.

fixtures.description: Deterministic test fixture file paths and freshness validation policy.

paths.description: Repository-relative file paths to deterministic fixture JSON files.

liveFreshnessDays.description: Maximum days before live smoke re-verification is advised.

ratePolicy.description: Rate limiting concurrency and delay parameters.

concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent requests allowed for this scope.

delayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds between consecutive request dispatches.

purpose.description: Human-readable explanation of why this endpoint is accessed.

origins.description: Allowed URL origin patterns for this endpoint.

originKind.description: Whether origins are static/fixed or dynamically issued by the provider.

credentials.description: Credential transmission policy (cookies / auth headers) for requests to this endpoint.

redirect.description: HTTP redirect handling mode for requests to this endpoint.

maxResponseBytes.description: Maximum allowed response payload size in bytes.

endpointId.description: Target media endpoint id receiving dynamic origins.

sourceEndpointId.description: Source API endpoint id returning media host URLs.

allowedOriginPattern.description: Origin pattern template permitted for dynamic registration.

validator.description: Validation rule applied to issued dynamic URLs.

sessionRefererRule.description: Declarative Net Request session rule definition for Referer header modification.

id.description: Managed rule id within the 41000-41999 range.

requestDomains.description: Target request domain names where Referer headers will be injected.

resourceTypes.description: Web request resource types affected by this rule.

referer.description: Absolute HTTPS Referer header value to attach.

settingsField.description: Custom setting field definition rendered in Options UI.

labelKey.description: i18n message key for field label.

descriptionKey.description: Optional i18n message key for field description.

type.description: Data type and UI widget type for the setting field.

defaultValue.description: Default value matching the field type.

options.description: Selectable options for select and multiselect fields.

labelKey.description: i18n message key for the option label.
